subject: Tiered discount schedule + requested split invoicing for multi-year prepay
body:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@nimbushealth.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Multi-year prepay question: discount tiers + invoice split

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the proposal. Procurement has two outstanding asks before we can push the purchase to finance: one on the term discounts and the other on invoicing.

1) Tiered discount confirmation: Nimbus expects the year-over-year discount to step down (18% year1, 12% year2, 6% year3) if we commit to a 3-year prepay. Your term sheet shows a blended 12% — can you confirm the per-year tiers so our systems show the right ARR math?

2) Invoice splitting: Nimbus requires the vendor to issue invoices aligned to fiscal years for their internal revenue recognition. They prefer a split invoice for the multi-year prepay rather than one upfront invoice that they amortize internally. Their initial ask: 60% invoice in FY27 and 40% in FY28 for a 2-year commitment. Can Redwood do a 60/40 split on invoice issuance (not a credit note) and provide the SOW and GL code statements?

If you can confirm these two items today, I can expedite routing.

Best,
Aisha
Procurement Lead, Nimbus Health

---

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Multi-year prepay question: discount tiers + invoice split

Hi Aisha — thanks for the clear ask. Short answers up front, details below and I attached an editable invoice-split workbook for Nimbus to review.

- Tiered discounts: We can support the per-year tiers you listed (18% / 12% / 6%) on a 3-year prepaid commitment. We'll reflect per-year PRICING-LINE items in the SOW so accounting sees the year breakdown rather than a single blended line.

- Invoice split: We can issue multiple invoices tied to the SOW milestones. For a 2-year deal we can do 60% / 40% invoicing on signature, provided we record the total commitment in our contract system and the invoice terms reference the total amount. For ASC 606 reasons we need to mark the contract as a single performance obligation for the product (in our internal revenue system) but the billing cadence can be split as requested.

Next steps: Ben from Finance, can you confirm (1) GL codes we should put on each invoice line, (2) whether Redwood needs to generate a credit-note flow if Nimbus later requests a different invoice phasing. Laura from Sales Ops, can you produce the updated SOW with per-year price lines?

Attach: proposed_invoice_split.xlsx, redwood_term_sheet_2027-03-29.pdf

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

---

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Multi-year prepay question: discount tiers + invoice split

Priyom — quick internal note before we confirm back to Nimbus. The revenue recognition point is important: if we treat the deal as a single performance obligation (recommended), we must amortize revenue over the term even if we invoice 60/40. That is fine operationally, but accounting will need the invoice schedule to map to deferred revenue buckets.

Operational constraints:
- We can split invoice issuance 60/40 on signature, but our billing system requires a single Purchase Order (PO) referencing the SOW and a note that the invoices apply to the total commitment.
- GL codes: use REV-SUBS-ML (recurring subscription) for both invoices; finance will tag amounts to FY27/FY28 deferred revenue on our side.
- Credit-note flow: if Nimbus later requests full up-front and we had issued two invoices, we would either (a) issue a refund/credit and re-invoice or (b) keep invoices and adjust the amortization schedule; the preferred path is (b) unless procurement requires explicit refunds.

I attached a short worksheet (proposed_invoice_split.xlsx) with suggested line-level descriptions and GL allocations.

Ben
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

---

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Multi-year prepay question: discount tiers + invoice split

Hi Aisha — Laura here (Sales Ops). Attached is an updated SOW (NW_SOW_v3.pdf) that breaks out annual pricing lines to match the 3-year discount tiers you requested. For the 2-year scenario we changed the pricing to show Year1: list price less 18% and Year2: list price less 12%, with a total summary line. The SOW also contains the CLIN-style lines we typically include for multi-year prepaids so your auditors can map to fiscal periods.

As Ben noted: our accounting treatment will record revenue on a deferred schedule; however the invoice issuance can be split 60/40 as you prefer. Please confirm the PO number you will send and the exact FY boundary dates (your FY start/end) so we align the invoice dates exactly.

Attach: NW_SOW_v3.pdf

Best,
Laura Bennett
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

---

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@nimbushealth.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 08:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Multi-year prepay question: discount tiers + invoice split

Thanks — confirming PO will be PO-987654 and Nimbus FY runs Apr 1 — Mar 31. We want the first invoice dated Mar 31, 2027 (60%) and the second invoice dated Apr 1, 2028 (40%). That aligns to FY27/FY28 for our books. Please add the PO to each invoice and include the payment terms (Net 45).

Also — for audit compliance can you include the statement "Invoice issued per signed SOW NW_SOW_v3; total commitment recorded on contract NW-2027-0411" in the invoice memo field?

Best,
Aisha

---

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Multi-year prepay question: discount tiers + invoice split

Aisha — thanks for the PO and FY dates; confirming Redwood can proceed with the following agreed plan:

1) Pricing: Per-year discount tiers accepted for the 3-year option (18% / 12% / 6%) as documented in NW_SOW_v3. For the 2-year commitment (as Nimbus indicated in prior conversations), the SOW shows Year1 at 18% and Year2 at 12%.

2) Invoicing: Redwood will issue two invoices tied to the SOW and PO-987654:
   - Invoice #RWD-000451 dated 2027-03-31 for 60% of the total commitment (Net 45)
   - Invoice #RWD-000452 dated 2028-04-01 for 40% of the total commitment (Net 45)
   Both invoices will include: PO-987654 in the memo, the SOW reference (NW_SOW_v3), the HubSpot deal id (NW-2027-0411), and the statement "Invoice issued per signed SOW NW_SOW_v3; total commitment recorded on contract NW-2027-0411" in the invoice memo field.

3) Accounting note: Redwood Finance will record the total as a single contract in our system and amortize revenue over the contract term per ASC 606; the split invoices will be posted to REV-SUBS-ML and tagged to FY27/FY28 deferred buckets as discussed.

4) DocuSign: Laura will send the SOW for signature via DocuSign after I confirm final dollar amounts. Expected DocuSign link: https://docu.sign/example/NW-2027-0411

If that all looks good, we will generate RWD-000451 this afternoon once the SOW is signed and the PO is in our system.

Thanks everyone — moving to finalize.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
